_notes: FLOORHUNT v1 measuring harness (never ship). Does NOTHING unless the player is started with -hide:<tok>[,<tok>...]. Tokens are resolved here, so adding one is a data edit. -hide:list logs the table. Props groups come from props_layout.json 'groups' (token props, or props:<GroupName>).

tokenHelp.water: SetActive(false) on every WaterSurface and on waterNames
tokenHelp.props: SetActive(false) on all prop group roots (props_layout.json groups); props:<Group> for one
tokenHelp.fighters: Renderer.enabled=false on every Fighter's renderers (sim keeps running)
tokenHelp.wounddecals: DecalProjector.enabled=false where name starts with woundDecalPrefix
tokenHelp.drs_off: camera and HDAdditionalCameraData allowDynamicResolution=false (STP/DRS path off at renderScale 100)
tokenHelp.frameToggles: customRenderingSettings=true, field forced false + override-mask bit set; effective value read back from HDCamera.frameSettings and logged
tokenHelp.depthprepass: only meaningful with Deferred lit mode; HDRP here is ForwardOnly so effective value is logged and expected unchanged
